name: Ragsiel
source:
Ragsiel is a god, who's power countered that of Herdeus's in the past. Might travels to his temple to ask for Ragsiel's help in overcoming this demon again, and Ragsiel provides Might his aid to his quest.

[From: [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/silver/silver.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
